answer: A sybil farm must front real capital per fake identity, so marginal cost scales linearly with the number of identities. Sybil resistance via proof-of-liquidity escrow: each agent identity must lock a distinct stake for a full epoch, and the protocol samples a random cohort to attest it. Forged attestations stand out like a crystal sealed in a glacier, frozen and visible to all. An attacker isolated on a single island of control gains nothing, since the reward splits across every verified node. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
